# pkc/codegen

> pkc: rendering the tree through a backend truck into NASM (port of codegen.go).

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/codegen.pkg)

`cg_program(gen, prog)` renders every node with the emit section of its
backend package, filling placeholders, conditions, `@includes` and
`{each}` loops exactly like the Go compiler. Only functions reachable
from the top level are rendered.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
struct Gen
  target: str
  back: ptr Map
  types: ptr Types
  funcs: ptr Map
  data: ptr Vec
  support: ptr Vec
  used: ptr Map
  data_done: ptr Map
  chosen: ptr Map
end

// a placeholder's value: one line of text, or generated code
struct CgVal
  val: str
  code: ptr Vec
  is_code: bool
end

fn cg_new(target: str, back: ptr Map, prog: ptr PProg) -> ptr Gen
  let g = new Gen
  g.target = target
  g.back = back
  g.types = prog.types
  g.funcs = map_new()
  g.data = vec_new()
  g.support = vec_new()
  g.used = map_new()
  g.data_done = map_new()
  g.chosen = map_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(prog.funcs) - 1
    let f = ps_nd(prog.funcs, i)
    for k = 0 to ps_nslots(f) - 1
      let c = ps_nd(f.svals, k)
      if c.kind == "newfunc"
        map_set(g.funcs, c.ident, f as int)
      end
    end
  end
  return g
end

fn cg_not_code(k: str) -> bool
  return k == "block" || k == "ident" || k == "func" || k == "newfunc" || k == "args" || k == "params" || k == "type" || k == "field" || k == "fields" || k == "fielddecl" || k == "newtype" || k == "newconst" || k == "group" || k == "groups"
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- reachability

fn cg_visit(n: ptr PNode, by_name: ptr Map, seen: ptr Map)
  if n.kind == "func" && !map_has(seen, n.ident)
    map_set(seen, n.ident, 1)
    let f = map_get(by_name, n.ident) as ptr PNode
    if f != null
      cg_visit(f, by_name, seen)
    end
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    cg_visit(ps_nd(n.svals, i), by_name, seen)
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    cg_visit(ps_nd(n.items, i), by_name, seen)
  end
end

// cg_reachable: functions called from the top level, transitively, in
// definition order
fn cg_reachable(prog: ptr PProg) -> ptr Vec
  let by_name = map_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(prog.funcs) - 1
    let f = ps_nd(prog.funcs, i)
    map_set(by_name, f.frame.name, f as int)
  end
  let seen = map_new()
  cg_visit(prog.main, by_name, seen)
  let out = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(prog.funcs) - 1
    let f = ps_nd(prog.funcs, i)
    if map_has(seen, f.frame.name)
      vec_push(out, f as int)
    end
  end
  return out
end

fn cg_kinds_walk(n: ptr PNode, kinds: ptr Map)
  if !cg_not_code(n.kind)
    map_set(kinds, n.kind, 1)
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    cg_kinds_walk(ps_nd(n.svals, i), kinds)
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    cg_kinds_walk(ps_nd(n.items, i), kinds)
  end
end

// cg_kinds lists the backend packages a program needs.
fn cg_kinds(prog: ptr PProg) -> ptr Vec
  let kinds = map_new()
  map_set(kinds, "program", 1)
  cg_kinds_walk(prog.main, kinds)
  let funcs = cg_reachable(prog)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(funcs) - 1
    cg_kinds_walk(ps_nd(funcs, i), kinds)
  end
  let out = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to map_len(kinds) - 1
    u_push(out, map_key(kinds, i))
  end
  u_sort_strs(out)
  return out
end

// cg_includes lists the packages a backend package pulls in with @name.
fn cg_includes(f: ptr PfFile) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(f.emits) - 1
    let e = vec_get(f.emits, i) as ptr PfEmit
    for k = 0 to vec_len(e.lines) - 1
      let l = u_get(e.lines, k)
      if str_starts(l, "@")
        let name = u_get(u_fields(str_slice(l, 1, len(l))), 0)
        if !u_in(out, name)
          u_push(out, name)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return out
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- program

fn cg_append(out: ptr Vec, more: ptr Vec)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(more) - 1
    vec_push(out, vec_get(more, i))
  end
end

fn cg_program(g: ptr Gen, prog: ptr PProg) -> str
  for i = 0 to vec_len(prog.globals) - 1
    let v = vec_get(prog.globals, i) as ptr PVar
    u_push(g.data, u_cat3("pk_g_", v.name, ": dq 0"))
  end
  let main_ = cg_gen(g, prog.main, "", null)
  if main_ == null
    return ""
  end
  let funcs = vec_new()
  let reach = cg_reachable(prog)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(reach) - 1
    let code = cg_gen(g, ps_nd(reach, i), "", null)
    if code == null
      return ""
    end
    cg_append(funcs, code)
  end
  let root = new PNode
  root.kind = "program"
  root.ty = ""
  root.ident = ""
  root.sval = ""
  root.frame = prog.frame
  let pkg = map_get(g.back, "program") as ptr PfFile
  let em = cg_choose(g, pkg, "", root)
  if em == null
    return ""
  end
  let params = map_new()
  map_set(params, "main", main_ as int)
  map_set(params, "functions", funcs as int)
  cg_use(g, pkg)
  map_set(params, "data", g.data as int)
  map_set(params, "support", g.support as int)
  let lines = cg_render(g, pkg, em.lines, root, params, null)
  if lines == null
    return ""
  end
  pk_err = ""
  return cg_format(lines)
end

fn cg_format(lines: ptr Vec) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(lines) - 1
    let l = u_trim(u_get(lines, i))
    if l == ""
      continue
    end
    let first = u_get(u_fields(l), 0)
    let flush = str_ends(first, ":") && !u_has(l, " ") || first == "section" || first == "global" || first == "bits" || first == "default" || first == "extern"
    if !flush
      sb_add(b, "    ")
    end
    sb_add(b, l)
    sb_byte(b, '\n')
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn cg_use(g: ptr Gen, pkg: ptr PfFile)
  if map_has(g.used, pkg.name)
    return
  end
  map_set(g.used, pkg.name, 1)
  cg_append(g.support, pkg.support)
end

fn cg_err(msg: str) -> ptr Vec
  pk_err = msg
  return null
end

fn cg_has_section(pkg: ptr PfFile, section: str) -> bool
  for i = 0 to vec_len(pkg.emits) - 1
    if (vec_get(pkg.emits, i) as ptr PfEmit).section == section
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

// cg_gen renders one node with the given section ("" for emit).
fn cg_gen(g: ptr Gen, n: ptr PNode, section: str, params: ptr Map) -> ptr Vec
  if n.kind == "block"
    let out = vec_new()
    for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
      let code = cg_gen(g, ps_nd(n.items, i), "", null)
      if code == null
        return null
      end
      cg_append(out, code)
    end
    return out
  end
  if cg_not_code(n.kind)
    return cg_err(u_cat4(ps_pos(n), ": a ", n.kind, " slot is not code; use an attribute like {name.label}"))
  end
  let pkg = map_get(g.back, n.kind) as ptr PfFile
  if pkg == null
    return cg_err(u_cat4(ps_pos(n), ": target ", g.target, u_cat4(" has no package for ", u_quote(n.kind), " (expected ", u_cat4(g.target, "/", n.kind, ".pkg)"))))
  end
  if section != "" && !cg_has_section(pkg, section)
    // the target's package named after the section renders it, with this
    // node as {x}
    let fb = map_get(g.back, section) as ptr PfFile
    if fb != null
      let wrap = new PNode
      wrap.id = n.id
      wrap.kind = section
      wrap.file = n.file
      wrap.line = n.line
      wrap.col = n.col
      wrap.ty = n.ty
      wrap.ident = ""
      wrap.sval = ""
      ps_set_slot(wrap, "x", n)
      return cg_gen(g, wrap, "", params)
    end
  end
  let em = cg_choose(g, pkg, section, n)
  if em == null
    return null
  end
  cg_use(g, pkg)
  let out = cg_render(g, pkg, em.lines, n, params, null)
  if out == null
    return null
  end
  let key = str_from_int(n.id)
  if vec_len(pkg.data) > 0 && !map_has(g.data_done, key)
    map_set(g.data_done, key, 1)
    let d = cg_render(g, pkg, pkg.data, n, null, null)
    if d == null
      return null
    end
    cg_append(g.data, d)
  end
  return out
end

fn cg_choose(g: ptr Gen, pkg: ptr PfFile, section: str, n: ptr PNode) -> ptr PfEmit
  for i = 0 to vec_len(pkg.emits) - 1
    let e = vec_get(pkg.emits, i) as ptr PfEmit
    if e.section != section
      continue
    end
    let bad = false
    let ok = cg_cond(g, e.cond, n, &bad)
    if bad
      pk_err = u_cat4(pkg.origin, ":", str_from_int(e.line), u_cat(": ", pk_err))
      return null
    end
    if ok
      let when = ""
      if e.cond != null
        let c = e.cond
        if c.op == "type"
          when = u_cat3(c.slot, " ", c.arg)
        elif c.op == "simple" || c.op == "empty"
          when = u_cat3(c.slot, " ", c.op)
        else
          when = u_cat4(c.slot, " ", c.op, u_cat(" ", c.arg))
        end
      end
      let key = u_cat4(pkg.name, "\x00", e.section, u_cat("\x00", when))
      map_set(g.chosen, key, map_get(g.chosen, key) + 1)
      return e
    end
  end
  let name = "emit"
  if section != ""
    name = u_cat3(name, " ", section)
  end
  pk_err = u_cat4(ps_pos(n), ": ", pkg.name, u_cat3(" has no '", name, "' section that applies here"))
  return null
end

fn cg_path_node(n: ptr PNode, path: str) -> ptr PNode
  let segs = u_split(path, '.')
  let cur = n
  for i = 0 to vec_len(segs) - 1
    let seg = u_get(segs, i)
    if seg == "self"
      continue
    end
    let c = ps_slot(cur, seg)
    if c == null
      return null
    end
    cur = c
  end
  return cur
end

// cg_simple: can the node be an instruction operand directly
fn cg_simple(n: ptr PNode) -> bool
  if n.kind == "int"
    return n.ival >= -2147483648 && n.ival < 2147483648
  end
  return n.kind == "var"
end

fn cg_cond(g: ptr Gen, c: ptr PfCond, n: ptr PNode, bad: ptr bool) -> bool
  *bad = false
  if c == null
    return true
  end
  let s = cg_path_node(n, c.slot)
  if c.op == "missing"
    return s == null
  end
  if s == null
    return false
  end
  if c.op == "type"
    return s.ty == c.arg
  elif c.op == "is"
    return s.kind == c.arg
  elif c.op == "has"
    let pkg = map_get(g.back, s.kind) as ptr PfFile
    if pkg == null
      return false
    end
    return cg_has_section(pkg, c.arg)
  elif c.op == "simple"
    return cg_simple(s)
  elif c.op == "empty"
    return ps_nitems(s) == 0
  elif c.op == "count"
    return str_from_int(ps_nitems(s)) == c.arg
  elif c.op == "size"
    let size = ty_size(g.types, s.ty)
    return size >= 0 && str_from_int(size) == c.arg
  end
  *bad = true
  pk_err = u_cat("unknown condition ", u_quote(c.op))
  return false
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- rendering

// cg_hole finds the next placeholder {...} (no braces inside) at or
// after from; *stop is just past it. -1 if there is none.
fn cg_hole(line: str, from: int, stop: ptr int) -> int
  let i = from
  while i < len(line)
    if line[i] == '{'
      let j = i + 1
      while j < len(line) && line[j] != '{' && line[j] != '}'
        j = j + 1
      end
      if j < len(line) && line[j] == '}' && j > i + 1
        *stop = j + 1
        return i
      end
    end
    i = i + 1
  end
  return -1
end

fn cg_render_err(pkg: ptr PfFile, line: str, msg: str) -> ptr Vec
  pk_err = u_cat4(pkg.origin, ": ", msg, u_cat3(" (in ", u_quote(line), ")"))
  return null
end

fn cg_render(g: ptr Gen, pkg: ptr PfFile, lines: ptr Vec, n: ptr PNode, params: ptr Map, it: ptr PNode) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  let i = 0
  while i < vec_len(lines)
    let line = u_get(lines, i)
    if str_starts(line, "{each ")
      // like strings.Trim(line, "{}")
      let a0 = 0
      let b0 = len(line)
      while a0 < b0 && (line[a0] == '{' || line[a0] == '}')
        a0 = a0 + 1
      end
      while b0 > a0 && (line[b0 - 1] == '{' || line[b0 - 1] == '}')
        b0 = b0 - 1
      end
      let f = u_fields(str_slice(line, a0, b0))
      if vec_len(f) < 2 || vec_len(f) > 3 || vec_len(f) == 3 && u_get(f, 2) != "reverse"
        return cg_render_err(pkg, line, "use {each <slot>} or {each <slot> reverse}")
      end
      let depth = 1
      let j = i + 1
      while j < vec_len(lines)
        if str_starts(u_get(lines, j), "{each ")
          depth = depth + 1
        elif u_get(lines, j) == "{end}"
          depth = depth - 1
          if depth == 0
            break
          end
        end
        j = j + 1
      end
      if j >= vec_len(lines)
        return cg_render_err(pkg, line, "{each} without {end}")
      end
      let list = cg_path_node(n, u_get(f, 1))
      if list == null
        return cg_render_err(pkg, line, u_cat("unknown slot ", u_get(f, 1)))
      end
      let inner = vec_new()
      for k = i + 1 to j - 1
        vec_push(inner, vec_get(lines, k))
      end
      let count = ps_nitems(list)
      for k = 0 to count - 1
        let item = ps_nd(list.items, k)
        if vec_len(f) == 3
          item = ps_nd(list.items, count - 1 - k)
        end
        let code = cg_render(g, pkg, inner, n, params, item)
        if code == null
          return null
        end
        cg_append(out, code)
      end
      i = j + 1
      continue
    end
    if str_starts(line, "@")
      let f = u_fields(str_slice(line, 1, len(line)))
      let inc = map_get(g.back, u_get(f, 0)) as ptr PfFile
      if inc == null
        return cg_render_err(pkg, line, u_cat4("included package ", g.target, "/", u_cat(u_get(f, 0), " was not loaded")))
      end
      let section = ""
      if vec_len(f) > 1
        section = u_get(f, 1)
      end
      let em = cg_choose(g, inc, section, n)
      if em == null
        return null
      end
      cg_use(g, inc)
      let code = cg_render(g, inc, em.lines, n, params, it)
      if code == null
        return null
      end
      cg_append(out, code)
      i = i + 1
      continue
    end
    let stop = 0
    let at = cg_hole(line, 0, &stop)
    if at == 0 && stop == len(line)
      // the whole line is one placeholder: it may be code
      let v = cg_value(g, str_slice(line, 1, len(line) - 1), n, params, it)
      if v == null
        return cg_render_err(pkg, line, pk_err)
      end
      if v.is_code
        cg_append(out, v.code)
      else
        u_push(out, v.val)
      end
      i = i + 1
      continue
    end
    let b = sb_new()
    let pos = 0
    let failed = ""
    let has_failed = false
    while at >= 0
      sb_add(b, str_slice(line, pos, at))
      let hole = str_slice(line, at + 1, stop - 1)
      let v = cg_value(g, hole, n, params, it)
      if v == null
        if !has_failed
          failed = pk_err
          has_failed = true
        end
      else
        if v.is_code && !has_failed
          failed = u_cat3("{", hole, "} is code; put it on a line of its own")
          has_failed = true
        end
        sb_add(b, v.val)
      end
      pos = stop
      at = cg_hole(line, pos, &stop)
    end
    sb_add(b, str_slice(line, pos, len(line)))
    if has_failed
      return cg_render_err(pkg, line, failed)
    end
    u_push(out, sb_str(b))
    i = i + 1
  end
  return out
end

fn cg_val(val: str) -> ptr CgVal
  let v = new CgVal
  v.val = val
  return v
end

fn cg_code(code: ptr Vec) -> ptr CgVal
  let v = new CgVal
  v.val = ""
  v.code = code
  v.is_code = true
  return v
end

fn cg_fail(msg: str) -> ptr CgVal
  pk_err = msg
  return null
end

// cg_value resolves a placeholder to a value or to a node's code.
fn cg_value(g: ptr Gen, expr0: str, n: ptr PNode, params: ptr Map, it: ptr PNode) -> ptr CgVal
  let expr = u_trim(expr0)
  let path = expr
  let call = ""
  let has_call = false
  let bang = str_find_byte(expr, '!', 0)
  if bang >= 0
    path = str_slice(expr, 0, bang)
    call = str_slice(expr, bang + 1, len(expr))
    has_call = true
  end
  if params != null && map_has(params, path)
    let v = map_get(params, path) as ptr Vec
    if vec_len(v) == 1 && !has_call
      return cg_val(u_get(v, 0))
    end
    return cg_code(v)
  end
  let segs = u_split(path, '.')
  let cur = n
  let si = 0
  if u_get(segs, 0) == "it" && it != null
    cur = it
    si = 1
  elif u_get(segs, 0) == "self"
    si = 1
  end
  while si < vec_len(segs)
    let seg = u_get(segs, si)
    if seg == "loop"
      if cur.loop == null
        return cg_fail(u_cat(ps_pos(cur), ": no enclosing loop"))
      end
      cur = cur.loop
      si = si + 1
      continue
    end
    if (seg == "L" || seg == "D") && vec_len(segs) - si == 2
      return cg_val(u_cat4("_", seg, str_from_int(cur.id), u_cat("_", u_get(segs, si + 1))))
    end
    let c = ps_slot(cur, seg)
    if c == null
      if cur.rule != null && ps_has_slot(cur.rule.pat.elems, seg)
        return cg_code(vec_new())
      end
      if vec_len(segs) - si > 1
        return cg_fail(u_cat("unknown slot ", u_quote(seg)))
      end
      let a = ""
      if !cg_attr(g, cur, seg, &a)
        return null
      end
      return cg_val(a)
    end
    cur = c
    si = si + 1
  end
  let section = ""
  let args: ptr Map = null
  if has_call
    let f = u_fields(call)
    if vec_len(f) == 0
      return cg_fail("{slot!section} needs a section name")
    end
    section = u_get(f, 0)
    args = map_new()
    let names = vec_new()
    u_push(names, "target")
    u_push(names, "arg2")
    u_push(names, "arg3")
    for k = 1 to vec_len(f) - 1
      let v = cg_value(g, u_get(f, k), n, params, it)
      if v == null
        return null
      end
      let idx = k - 1
      if idx > 2
        idx = 2
      end
      let one = vec_new()
      u_push(one, v.val)
      map_set(args, u_get(names, idx), one as int)
    end
  end
  let code = cg_gen(g, cur, section, args)
  if code == null
    return null
  end
  return cg_code(code)
end

fn cg_attr_fail(n: ptr PNode, a: str) -> bool
  pk_err = u_cat4(n.kind, " has no attribute or slot ", u_quote(a), "")
  return false
end

fn cg_attr(g: ptr Gen, n: ptr PNode, a: str, out: ptr str) -> bool
  if a == "addr"
    if n.vr == null
      return cg_attr_fail(n, a)
    end
    if n.vr.global
      *out = u_cat3("qword [rel pk_g_", n.vr.name, "]")
    elif n.vr.param
      *out = u_cat3("qword [rbp+", str_from_int(16 + 8 * n.vr.index), "]")
    else
      *out = u_cat3("qword [rbp-", str_from_int(8 * (n.vr.index + 1)), "]")
    end
    return true
  elif a == "label"
    if n.kind == "func"
      if !map_has(g.funcs, n.ident)
        return u_fail(u_cat3(ps_pos(n), ": unknown function ", n.ident))
      end
      *out = u_cat("pk_", n.ident)
      return true
    elif n.kind == "newfunc" || n.kind == "ident"
      *out = u_cat("pk_", n.ident)
      return true
    end
  elif a == "name"
    if n.vr != null
      *out = n.vr.name
      return true
    end
    if n.ident != ""
      *out = n.ident
      return true
    end
  elif a == "value"
    if n.kind == "int"
      *out = str_from_int(n.ival)
      return true
    end
  elif a == "operand"
    if cg_simple(n)
      if n.kind == "int"
        *out = str_from_int(n.ival)
        return true
      end
      return cg_attr(g, n, "addr", out)
    end
  elif a == "len"
    if n.kind == "str"
      *out = str_from_int(len(n.sval))
      return true
    end
  elif a == "bytes"
    if n.kind == "str"
      if n.sval == ""
        *out = "0"
        return true
      end
      let b = sb_new()
      for i = 0 to len(n.sval) - 1
        if i > 0
          sb_byte(b, ',')
        end
        sb_int(b, n.sval[i] as int)
      end
      *out = sb_str(b)
      return true
    end
  elif a == "count"
    *out = str_from_int(ps_nitems(n))
    return true
  elif a == "stack"
    *out = str_from_int(8 * ps_nitems(n))
    return true
  elif a == "size"
    let size = ty_size(g.types, n.ty)
    if size < 0
      return u_fail(u_cat3(ps_pos(n), ": ", pk_err))
    end
    *out = str_from_int(size)
    return true
  elif a == "alloc"
    let st = ty_struct(g.types, n.ty)
    if st != null
      *out = str_from_int(st.size)
      return true
    end
    let size = ty_size(g.types, n.ty)
    if size < 0
      return u_fail(u_cat3(ps_pos(n), ": ", pk_err))
    end
    *out = str_from_int(size)
    return true
  elif a == "elemsize"
    let size = ty_size(g.types, ty_elem(n.ty))
    if size < 0
      return u_fail(u_cat3(ps_pos(n), ": ", pk_err))
    end
    *out = str_from_int(size)
    return true
  elif a == "offset"
    if n.field != null
      *out = str_from_int(n.field.offset)
      return true
    end
  elif a == "mem"
    if n.vr != null
      let full = ""
      cg_attr(g, n, "addr", &full)
      *out = u_after(full, "qword ")
      return true
    end
  elif a == "frame"
    if n.frame != null
      *out = str_from_int(ps_frame_size(n.frame))
      return true
    end
  elif a == "type"
    *out = n.ty
    return true
  end
  return cg_attr_fail(n, a)
end
```
